mapper.select: SELECT sod.id as detail_id, sod.stocktake_order_id, sod.product_id, sod.batch_no, sod.location_id, sod.system_quantity, sod.first_count, sod.second_count, sod.final_count, sod.diff_quantity, sod.diff_type, sod.unit, sod.is_counted, sod.count_time, sod.counter, sod.diff_reason, sod.process_status, sod.process_result, sod.process_time, sod.processor, sod.remark as detail_remark, sod.create_time as detail_create_time, sod.update_time as detail_update_time, p.product_code, p.product_name, l.location_code, CASE sod.diff_type WHEN 1 THEN '盘盈' WHEN 2 THEN '盘亏' WHEN 3 THEN '无差异' ELSE '未知' END as diff_type_name FROM wms_stocktake_order_detail sod LEFT JOIN wms_product p ON sod.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON sod.location_id = l.id WHERE sod.stocktake_order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY sod.id
